facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: $180K initial investment for selected teams + potential additional $320K uncapped follow-on
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Selected teams pitch investment committee at end of residency
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: $180K SAFE for 11% equity; additional $320K uncapped follow-on opportunity.
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Dubai/Riyadh residency; choose MENAP location and meet visa/entry requirements.
facts_raw.Can Apply Pre-Idea: Yes / validating idea and cofounder matching supported
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early-stage founder/team serious about building; residency is 10 weeks; investment only for selected teams.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.International Founder: Yes, subject to residency entry requirements
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: AI / AI-native；阶段以 Pre-seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；纯线下传统业务、缺乏可规模化技术产品
